arxiv-2010-01307.title: Phenomenology of vector-like leptons with Deep Learning at the Large Hadron Collider
arxiv-2010-01307.creator: Felipe F. Freitas, João Gonçalves, António P. Morais, Roman Pasechnik
arxiv-2010-01307.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Felipe F. Freitas, João Gonçalves, António P. Morais, Roman Pasechnik. In this paper, a model inspired by Grand Unification principles featuring three generations of vector-like fermions, new Higgs doublets and a rich neutrino sector at the low scale is presented. Using the state-of-the-art Deep Learning techniques we perform the first phenomenological analysis of this model focusing on the study of new charged vector-like leptons (VLLs) and their possible signatures at CERN’s Large Hadron Collider (LHC).

arxiv-2102-06218.title: Wavefunction collapse induced by gravity in a relativistic Schródinger-Newton model
arxiv-2102-06218.creator: Luis A. Poveda
arxiv-2102-06218.description: Abstract A relativistic version of the Schrödinger-Newton equation is analyzed within the recently proposed Grave de Peralta approach [L. Grave de Peralta, Results Phys. 18 (2020) 103318], which include relativistic effects by a parametrization of the non-relativistic hamiltonian, so as to impose that the average kinetic energy of the system coincide with its relativistic kinetic energy.

arxiv-2211-04659.title: When is Momentum Extragradient Optimal? A Polynomial-Based Analysis
arxiv-2211-04659.creator: Junhyung Lyle Kim jlylekim@rice.eduRice University, Department of Computer Science Gauthier Gidel gauthier.gidel@umontreal.caUniversité de Montréal, Department of Computer Science and Operations ResearchMila – Quebec AI Institute, Canada CIFAR AI Chair Anastasios Kyrillidis anastasios@rice.eduRice U
arxiv-2211-04659.description: Abstract The extragradient method has gained popularity due to its robust convergence properties for differentiable games. Unlike single-objective optimization, game dynamics involve complex interactions reflected by the eigenvalues of the game vector field’s Jacobian scattered across the complex plane. This complexity can cause the simple gradient method to diverge, even for bilinear games, while the extragradient method achieves convergence.

arxiv-2301-03546.title: DESY 23-001 UWThPh-2023-1 Investigation of the scale dependence in the MSR and MS ¯ \overline{\textrm{MS}} top quark mass schemes for the t ​ t ¯ {\mathrm{t}{}\overline{\mathrm{t}}} invariant mass differential cross section using LHC data
arxiv-2301-03546.creator: Toni Mäkelä, André H. Hoang, Katerina Lipka, Sven-Olaf Moch
arxiv-2301-03546.description: Abstract The computation of the single-differential top quark-antiquark pair ( t ​ t ¯ {\mathrm{t}{}\overline{\mathrm{t}}} ) production cross section at NLO in the fixed-order expansion is examined consistently using the MSR and MS ¯ \overline{\textrm{MS}} short-distance top quark mass schemes.

arxiv-2302-14206.title: Magnetic field control of light-induced spin accumulation in monolayer MoSe 2
arxiv-2302-14206.creator: Rafael R. Rojas-Lopez, Freddie Hendriks, Caspar H. van der Wal, Paulo S. S. Guimarães, Marcos H. D. Guimarães
arxiv-2302-14206.description: Abstract Semiconductor transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) have equivalent dynamics for their two spin/valley species. This arises from their energy-degenerated spin states, connected via time-reversal symmetry. When an out-of-plane magnetic field is applied, time-reversal symmetry is broken and the energies of the spin-polarized bands shift, resulting in different bandgaps and dynamics in the K + and K - valleys.

arxiv-2304-12800.title: Integral Field Spectroscopy of the Cometary Starburst Galaxy NGC 4861 Integral Field Spectroscopy of the Cometary Starburst Galaxy NGC 4861 – 2023
arxiv-2304-12800.creator: Nathan Roche, José M. Vílchez, Jorge Iglesias-Páramo, Polychronis Papaderos, Sebastian F. Sánchez, Carolina Kehrig, Salvador Duarte Puertas
arxiv-2304-12800.description: Abstract Using the PMAS Integral Field Unit on the Calar Alto 3.5m telescope we observed the southern component (Markarian 59) of the ‘cometary’ starburst galaxy NGC 4861. Mrk 59 is centred on a giant nebula and concentration of stars 1 kpc in diameter. Strong H ​ α \rm H\alpha emission points to a star-formation rate (SFR) at least 0.

arxiv-2308-06971.title: Disco : A Functional Programming Language for Discrete Mathematics
arxiv-2308-06971.creator: Brent A. Yorgey
arxiv-2308-06971.description: Abstract Disco is a pure, strict, statically typed functional programming language designed to be used in the setting of a discrete mathematics course. The goals of the language are to introduce students to functional programming concepts early, and to enhance their learning of mathematics by providing a computational platform for them to play with.

arxiv-2402-12975.title: Besov Regularity of Weak solutions to a Class of Nonlinear Elliptic Equations F. Zhou is the corresponding author.
arxiv-2402-12975.creator: Huimin Cheng
arxiv-2402-12975.description: Abstract In this article, we study a Besov regularity estimate of weak solutions to a class of nonlinear elliptic equations in divergence form. The main purpose is to establish Calderón-Zygmund type estimate in Besov spaces with more general assumptions on coefficients, non-homogeneous term and integrable index.

arxiv-2404-14355.title: Pre-Calc: Learning to Use the Calculator Improves Numeracy in Language Models
arxiv-2404-14355.creator: Vishruth Veerendranath, Vishwa Shah, Kshitish Ghate
arxiv-2404-14355.description: Abstract Quantitative and numerical comprehension in language is an important task in many fields like education and finance, but still remains a challenging task for language models. While tool and calculator usage has shown to be helpful to improve mathematical reasoning in large pretrained decoder-only language models, this remains unexplored for smaller language models with encoders.

arxiv-2410-00472.title: A Unified Stability Theory for Classical and Monotone Markov Chains Thanks: This paper was written in part while the second author was visiting RIEB at Kobe University. We have benefited from financial support from the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (KAKENHI 15H05729) and Australian Rese
arxiv-2410-00472.creator: Takashi Kamihigashi, John Stachurski
arxiv-2410-00472.description: Abstract . This paper integrates two strands of the literature on stability of general state Markov chains: conventional, total variation based results and more recent order-theoretic results. First we introduce a complete metric over Borel probability measures based on “partial” stochastic dominance.

arxiv-2410-06566.title: Detecting Bias and Enhancing Diagnostic Accuracy in Large Language Models for Healthcare Journal: npj Digital Medicine
arxiv-2410-06566.creator: Pardis Sadat Zahraei 1 , and Zahra Shakeri 1,* 1 Dalla Lana School of Public Health, University of Toronto, Canada * Corresponding author, zahra.shakeri@utoronto.ca
arxiv-2410-06566.description: Abstract Biased AI-generated medical advice and misdiagnoses can jeopardize patient safety, making the integrity of AI in healthcare more critical than ever. As Large Language Models (LLMs) take on a growing role in medical decision-making, addressing their biases and enhancing their accuracy is key to delivering safe, reliable care.

arxiv-2410-07514.title: O1O: Grouping of Known Classes to Identify Unknown Objects as Odd-One-Out
arxiv-2410-07514.creator: Mısra Yavuz, Fatma Güney
arxiv-2410-07514.description: Abstract This supplementary document provides our superclass formulation (Section 6 ), implementation details for our method (Section 7 ), additional ablations for superclass groups as well as source and number of pseudo-labels (Section 8 ), and qualitative examples including some failure cases and comparison to previous methods (Section 9 ).

arxiv-2501-11099.title: The JWST EXCELS survey: an extremely metal-poor galaxy at 𝐳 = 8.271 \mathbf{z=8.271} hosting an unusual population of massive stars
arxiv-2501-11099.creator: F. Cullen, A. C. Carnall, D. Scholte, D. J. McLeod, R. J. McLure, K. Z. Arellano-Córdova, T. M. Stanton, C. T. Donnan, J. S. Dunlop, A. E. Shapley, L. Barrufet, R. Begley, C. Bondestam, M. Cirasuolo, H.-H. Leung, C. L. Pollock, S. Stevenson
arxiv-2501-11099.description: Abstract We present an analysis of the rest-frame optical ( λ ≃ 3100 − 5600 \lambda\simeq 3100-5600\, Å) spectrum of a log 10 ​ ( M ∗ / M ⊙ ) = 8.6 \mathrm{log}_{10}(M_{*}/\mathrm{M_{\odot}})=8.6 star-forming galaxy at z = 8.271 z=8.271 from JWST /NIRSpec medium-resolution observations taken as part of the Early eXtragalactic Continuum and Emission Line Science (EXCELS) survey.

arxiv-2509-04725.title: Tailoring spatial correlations with quantum interference
arxiv-2509-04725.creator: Carlo Schiano, Bereneice Sephton, Elnaz Darsheshdar, Lorenzo Marrucci, Corrado de Lisio, Vincenzo D’Ambrosio
arxiv-2509-04725.description: Abstract Photon correlations represent a central resource in many quantum optics experiments, with applications ranging from quantum information protocols to sensing. Engineering such correlations is often challenging, especially in multi-particle scenarios. In this work we describe an effective method for shaping spatial correlations between photons by patterning their distinguishability in a quantum interference setup.

arxiv-2601-02218.title: MLIR-Smith: A Novel Random Program Generator for Evaluating Compiler Pipelines
arxiv-2601-02218.creator: Berke Ates, Filip Dobrosavljević, Theodoros Theodoridis, Zhendong Su
arxiv-2601-02218.description: Abstract . Compilers are essential for the performance and correct execution of software and hold universal relevance across various scientific disciplines. Despite this, there is a notable lack of tools for testing and evaluating them, especially within the adaptable Multi-Level Intermediate Representation (MLIR) context.

arxiv-2601-11225.title: Operators and POVMs generated by Parseval frames
arxiv-2601-11225.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by . Let ℱ e {\cal F}_{e} be a Parseval frame in a Hilbert space ℋ {\cal H} and let 𝖤 {\sf E} be a set of real numbers. From these data, we construct an operator H 𝖤 , e H_{{\sf E},e} and a positive operator-valued measure (POVM) F 𝖤 , e F_{{\sf E},e} This paper investigates in detail the relationship between the operator H 𝖤 , e H_{{\sf E},e} and the POVM F 𝖤 , e F_{{\sf E},e} .

nasa-tm-19660015402-on-the-production-of.title: On the production of low-energy cosmic-ray electrons
nasa-tm-19660015402-on-the-production-of.creator: Unknown
nasa-tm-19660015402-on-the-production-of.description: NASA technical report. On production of low energy cosmic ray electron

pmc-12374840.title: Linking leaf hyperspectral reflectance to gene expression
pmc-12374840.creator: Yanni Chen, Logan Monks, Vanessa E Rubio, Alexander J Cox, Nathan G Swenson
pmc-12374840.description: Forest diversity and dynamics are governed by the interactions between organismal function and the abiotic and biotic environment. Functional traits have been widely employed in forest ecology to estimate key functional tradeoffs related to tree performance in a given environment.

pmc-12396127.title: Herpes zoster vaccination and vaccine preferences among persons aged 50–64 years in Australia: Findings from a discrete choice experiment
pmc-12396127.creator: Sumitra Shantakumar, John Litt, Robert Booy, Lawrence Vandervoort, Vince Grillo, Emma Bandy, Raunak Parikh
pmc-12396127.description: Vaccine-preventable herpes zoster (HZ) poses substantial burden among Australian adults ≥50 years of age (YOA) despite available vaccination. This study aimed to understand the HZ vaccine-related preferences of adults paying out-of-pocket for HZ vaccination, to facilitate targeted recommendations by physicians and ultimately reduce disease burden.

pmc-12471460.title: Exploration of Methods for In Situ Scale Removal During Magnesium Hydroxide Membrane Crystallization
pmc-12471460.creator: Ester Komačková, Lukáš Sedlák, Ivan Červeňanský, Jozef Markoš
pmc-12471460.description: In coastal countries facing a shortage of drinking water, seawater desalination is essential for the production of potable water. During desalination, a large volume of waste stream, known as brine, is generated. This stream contains high concentrations of salts, particularly those of economic importance to the European Union, such as magnesium and calcium.

pmc-12473956.title: Advances in Gold Nanoparticles for the Diagnosis and Management of Alzheimer’s Disease
pmc-12473956.creator: Bhagavathi Sundaram Sivamaruthi, Periyanaina Kesika, Natarajan Sisubalan, Chaiyavat Chaiyasut, Ionela Cristina Voinea, Sorina Nicoleta Petrache Voicu
pmc-12473956.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) presents a significant challenge in modern healthcare, prompting exploration into novel therapeutic strategies. This review clearly classifies different types of gold (Au) nanoparticles (NPs) (AuNPs), links them to the gut–brain axis, highlights recent advances, and points out future research needs, offering a more updated perspective than earlier reviews.

pmc-12526287.title: Food Frequency Questionnaire to Estimate Dietary Adherence in Hemodialysis Patients: A Pilot Study
pmc-12526287.creator: Łukasz Czyżewski, Agnieszka Stelęgowska, Magdalena Durlik, Janusz Wyzgał, Andrzej Silczuk, Beata Irena Sińska, Maria Luz Fernandez
pmc-12526287.description: Background/Objectives: Stage 5 chronic kidney disease (CKD), or end-stage renal disease (ESRD), requires renal replacement therapy, commonly hemodialysis (HD). This treatment necessitates dietary changes due to impaired excretory function and protein-energy wasting (PEW). A structured diet with adequate energy, protein, electrolytes, and fluids is essential.

pmc-12573876.title: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the monthly proportion of male births and spontaneous fetal death rates in Japan: a descriptive epidemiological study using national vital statistics
pmc-12573876.creator: Mihoko Takahashi
pmc-12573876.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundA significant decrease in secondary sex ratio in December 2020 in Japan has been reported, suggesting the COVID-19 pandemic was a population-level stressor. However, few studies have investigated detailed trends in secondary sex ratio during the pandemic.

pmc-12594350.title: Mechanistic insights into excitonic and electrostatic stimulation of cells by photovoltaic substrates/nanocrystals and through light polarization modulation
pmc-12594350.creator: Mohammad Mohammadiaria, Daniel L. Rathbun, Moses Kamita, Shashi Bhushan Srivastava
pmc-12594350.description: Photoelectrical stimulation of cells and neural modulation via the separation of photo-induced electrical charges in photocapacitor structures have proven effective and biocompatible for therapeutic applications, such as retinal prostheses. Recent advances in photovoltaic materials and device architectures, particularly the use of pixelated photoelectrodes, have enabled high-resolution modulation of neuronal transmembrane potentials.

pmc-12610603.title: Defense and Adaptive Strategies of Crithmum maritimum L. Against Insect Herbivory: Evidence of Phenotypic Plasticity
pmc-12610603.creator: Liliya Naui, Yassine M’rabet, Bilel Halouani, Najet Chaabene, Faten Mezni, Abdelhamid Khaldi, Karim Hosni, Brian Traw
pmc-12610603.description: Insect herbivory exerts strong selective pressure on plants, yet no study has documented its effects on the halophytic Apiaceae Crithmum maritimum L. (sea fennel). Here, we present the first evidence of natural insect attack on this species, based on five Tunisian coastal populations distributed along a transparent bioclimatic gradient—from sub-humid to semi-arid—and exposed to different levels of herbivory.

pmc-13044339.title: Veterinarians’ perspectives on animal welfare, legal enforcement, and forensic readiness in companion animal cruelty investigations in Thailand: A cross-sectional qualitative study
pmc-13044339.creator: Athip Lorsirigool, Yuttana Sudjaroen, Narong Kulnides, Natapol Pumipuntu, Atthaporn Roongsitthichai, Supawadee Piratae, Manakant Intrakamhaeng, Surangkanang Chaiyasak, Kanokpon Saenkaew
pmc-13044339.description: Background and Aim:Animal cruelty is a persistent concern for animal welfare and society worldwide. In Thailand, the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals and Animal Welfare Act B.E. 2557 (2014) provides a legal framework to address animal abuse; however, effective enforcement remains constrained by limitations in investigative procedures and the limited integration of veterinary forensic science.

pmc-13164235.title: Complications and Revision Patterns After 3D-Printed Vertebral Body Replacement for Spinal Tumors: A Systematic Review and Critical Appraisal
pmc-13164235.creator: Viktor Aleinikov, Talgat Kerimbayev, Daryn Borangaliyev, Galymzhan Kadirbekov, Zhandos Tuigynov, Nurzhan Abishev, Daniyar K. Zhamoldin, Meirzhan Oshayev, Yergen Kenzhegulov, Yermek Urunbayev, Zhanibek Baiturlin, Makar Solodovnikov, Serik Akshulakov
pmc-13164235.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background: Three-dimensional (3D)-printed vertebral body replacement (VBR) and artificial vertebral body (AVB) implants are increasingly used for anterior column reconstruction after spinal tumor resection. However, the available evidence on complications remains limited, heterogeneous, and methodologically inconsistent. This systematic review aimed to synthesize reported complications, revision patterns, and mechanical outcomes of 3D-printed VBR/AVB implants in spinal oncology and to critically appraise the quality of the available clinical literature. Methods: This systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020.

pmc-13245631.title: Making Fluorescent Nylon, Polypropylene, and Polystyrene Microplastics for In Vivo and In Vitro Imaging
pmc-13245631.creator: Charles E. Bardawil, Jarrett Dobbins, Shannon Lankford, Saif Chowdrey, Jack Shumway, Gayathriy Balamayooran, Cedric Schaack, Rajeev Dhupar
pmc-13245631.description: Microplastics (MPs) are synthetic environmental pollutants increasingly linked to adverse human health effects. To study their biological impact, researchers require access to environmentally relevant MPs that can be accurately tracked in biological systems. However, most ambient MPs are composed of non-conjugated polymers that lack intrinsic fluorescence, limiting their utility in live-cell or in vivo imaging.

pmc-13290783.title: Impact of DJ stenting on subacute renal recovery after flexible ureterorenoscopy
pmc-13290783.creator: Gökhan Ecer, Selim Soytürk, Eren Erol, Abdullah Altunhan, Haider Nihad Izaddin Alalam, Selçuk Güven, Mehmet Balasar

pmc-13293070.title: Helium Plasma Radiofrequency for Aesthetic Subdermal Treatment: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-13293070.creator: Sachin M Shridharani, Aris Sterodimas, Manya R Harsch, Kari A Larson
pmc-13293070.description: Helium plasma radiofrequency (RF) technology (Renuvion, Apyx Medical, Clearwater, FL) has emerged as a minimally invasive option for treating skin laxity, either as a standalone procedure or as an adjunct to liposuction. While clinical adoption has expanded rapidly, the literature remains heterogeneous, with variable study designs and outcomes.

pmc-13308653.title: Exploring school nurses’ potential to strengthen young people’s resilience to misinformation by promoting critical health literacy in Norway
pmc-13308653.creator: Christine Holst, Heather Menzies Munthe-Kaas, Lena Victoria Nordheim, Mariann Enoksen, Sarah Rosenbaum
pmc-13308653.description: Young people are increasingly exposed to health misinformation, especially in social media. They often lack the skills necessary to think critically about misleading claims they encounter and decisions they make. The Informed Health Choices framework provides principles for critical health literacy.

pmc-13332014.title: A deep learning optimized model for classification and detection of rice leaf diseases
pmc-13332014.creator: Shashank Chaudhary, Upendra Kumar, Biswa Mohan Sahoo
pmc-13332014.description: Food productivity, quantity and quality are at stake when plant diseases such as rice diseases undermine the food security. Rice leaf disease treatment necessitates accurate and timely diagnosing. This study describes a deep learning model for categorizing and forecasting rice plant diseases. Using the remora optimization algorithm (ROA) on a rice leaf dataset demonstrates its potential for plant disease classification.

pmc-13479656.title: Role of Interventional Radiology in Management of C-Section Scar Ectopics
pmc-13479656.creator: Utsav Rajvanshi, Puneet Garg, Geetika Sindhwani, Resham Singh

pmc-13499841.title: Neural Correlates of Emotion Regulation in Substance Use
pmc-13499841.creator: Sasha J. Hofman, Abigail M. Whitney, Tara M. Chaplin
pmc-13499841.description: Purpose of ReviewEmotion regulation (ER) is a central process implicated in the development, maintenance, and escalation of substance use (SU) and substance use disorders (SUDs). Advances in functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) have enabled characterization of neural systems underlying emotional processing, inhibitory control under emotional conditions, and deliberate ER in individuals engaging in SU.

pmc-13573244.title: Peak Fiction: XRPD and the Illusion of Novelty
pmc-13573244.creator: Jeremy Rolquin, Shahin Shams, Mike Faley
pmc-13573244.description: This viewpoint addresses the growing use of X-ray powder diffraction (XRPD) data to support patent claims on crystalline forms of pharmaceutical compounds. XRPD patterns are inherent material properties, not inventions. We demonstrate that different sample preparations and holders impact the XRPD peaks returned for the same commercially available sample.

uslaw-usc-t39-s3213.title: 39 U.S.C. § 3213 — Seeds and reports from Department of Agriculture
uslaw-usc-t39-s3213.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t39-s3213.description: United States Code, Title 39 (Postal Service); Part IV (Mail Matter); Chapter 32 (Penalty And Franked Mail). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Seeds and agricultural reports emanating from the Department of Agriculture may be mailed— (1) as penalty mail by the Secretary of Agriculture; and (2) during the 90-day period immediately following the expiration of their terms of office, as franked mail.
